Config.Title: Spell Points
Config.EnabledHint: Each character or NPC is chosen on its own. When this is off, it casts with spell slots as usual.
Config.NoSlots: This actor has no spell slots from the Spellcasting feature (Pact Magic doesn't count), so spell points have nothing to replace. Spell points follow the slots dnd5e gives it: add a spellcasting class, or for an NPC set its spellcaster level.
Config.BonusHint: The table gives {base} spell points at spellcaster level {level}. The bonus is added to that and can be negative.
Config.OverrideHint: Leave empty to use the table plus the bonus. A number here replaces both.

Tables.Title: Spell Point Tables
Tables.Intro: These start as the Dungeon Master's Guide spell points tables. Changes apply to every spell point caster in this world straight away.
Tables.PointsHint: Spellcaster level is worked out the way dnd5e works out spell slots: full casters use their class level, half and third casters a share of it, and multiclass levels are combined. NPCs use their spellcaster level.
